He served as the minister of Surface Transport in 1999 and as the chief minister of Uttar Pradesh in 2000. He previously served as the 25th Union Minister of Home Affairs "Minister of Home Affairs (India)") in the first Modi ministry from 2014 to 2019, making him the first person born after Indian independence to hold the office.
